g.text: PF-F3. Next-day error for each supported regression output, pooled over the three stations
Evidence A: website historical scorecard cases (overall evidence)
Model: deployed GALE-CAST Model-W1 (SHA-256 f2db5aa9…9d14b0), historical scoring procedure (_w1_recall_floor.py: pooled scaled_weather inputs, 32-day
windows); X1 = same-date mean of the three stations' scores; warning if X1 ≥ 0.601 (threshold unchanged).
Cases: website cases with raw observations on the target and issue days; n = wind 3,421, mslp 3,423, humidity 3,421, rainfall 3,407. Truth: raw,
unimputed PAGASA values; rainfall in mm (GALE-CAST Model-W1 output inverted from log1p; trace −1 → 0.05 mm as in the pipeline).
Baselines: persistence = issue-day observation; climatology = station × month mean, 2015-01-01 to 2020-10-14. GALE-CAST Model-W1 = neural-only
Intervals: paired circular block bootstrap over target dates, 14-day blocks, 2,000 resamples, 95% percentile.
